- Option B: Tue Jun 23, 14:00–15:00 PT

We usually run the kickoff with this minimal attendee set: you (project sponsor), product/ops lead from your side, our CS lead, onboarding engineer, and the solutions engineer who will own the runbook. Can you confirm which option works and share the final attendee roster + roles?
